cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll find us a way out. Your shadow moved before you. What changed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was thinking of leaving, but I can't find the exit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay beside you. Think about that bench without moving. Does your shadow turn?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's gone to the bench. I'm still here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It follows what you want. Think about the exit; stay behind me while we follow it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 leads finding an exit, A3 supports B stationary test and A5 takes the front position while asking B to provide the intention that guides the shadow.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs a route and B4 supplies the actual observation that distinguishes intent from body motion.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts the observed rule into a test of the exit route, anchored to B2 need.

specificity.evidence: A1 shadow precedes B and A3 stationary test separate the strange fact from ordinary movement.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 stay behind me while we follow it gives a clear relative position without the tangled go-first wording.
